summary: This is a retail invoice issued by WS Retail Services Pvt. Ltd. to Anushrut Singh for the purchase of a SanDisk Ultra 16 GB MicroSDHC memory card. The order was placed on October 15, 2015, and the invoice was generated on October 20, 2015. The total amount due is 319.00 INR, which includes a promotional discount of 40.00 INR. The transaction was processed through Flipkart.com.
keyPoints: Seller: WS Retail Services Pvt. Ltd.

Product: SanDisk Ultra 16 GB MicroSDHC Class 10 48 MB/s Memory Card
